purpose: Replace global residual regression with four spatial heatmaps while retaining the detector-only reliability gate.

frozen_design.input: rgb-128x64 1.5x detector quad plus raw-detector-only 15d geometry and detector score
frozen_design.corner_objective: SmoothL1 soft-argmax coordinates + 0.05 * four-way spatial cross entropy
frozen_design.reliability_objective: 0.25 * class-weighted BCE for raw visual coordinate RMS >= 4 px
frozen_design.device_amendment_before_any_optimizer_st: The simulation-ml PyTorch build is CPU-only even though the host has an NVIDIA GPU; no checkpoint was produced by the rejected CUDA invocation.
frozen_design.selection: Pass aggregate, every-mode and reliability validation gates; then maximize aggregate RMS improvement, tie-break by least per-mode regression and lower seed.
